_note: Electrolysis cell: two electrodes in an electrolyte (salt water, or a battery's terminals on a wet tongue). 2-terminal: a, b (the electrodes). Engine (bw-board electrolysis_cell): electrolyte resistance ohms in series with the electrode interfaces: double-layer farads in parallel with the Faradaic (electrolysis) current, negligible below the decomposition voltage (onsetV ~1.7 V) and Tafel-exponential above it (tafelV, i0). Reports faradaicAmps, polarisationV, chargeC, hydrogenMol and a taste level (Faradaic current over tasteAmps, 20 uA).
